facts.fact: The court found Bolt Holdings OU, a named data processor and controller, in breach of sections 20, 21, 28 and 30 of Act 843 over a driver profile registered with the plaintiff's stolen identity, and awarded GHC1,900,000 compensation under section 43(1) plus GHC20,000 costs.

The judgment says the Data Protection Commission is established under Act 843 and orders it to see a forensic audit of Bolt's database and liveness checks by other ride-hailing platforms; it gives no appointment of members and no sign that the Commission has acted.
